methods.label: Use the common-difference definition
methods.explanation:
The common difference is the change from any term to the next. For every positive integer \(n\),
\[
a_{n+1}-a_n=[4(n+1)-1]-(4n-1)=4.
\]
This difference is constant, so the common difference is \(4\).
